name: ResourceState
purpose: A common boundary for loading, retained refresh, stale results, error and empty presentation.
description: Explicit presentation of host resource state. Retained data stays mounted during refresh/staleness.

props.name: retrying
props.description: Host-owned retry state; no promise or request lifecycle is inferred.

guidance.overview: A common boundary for loading, retained refresh, stale results, error and empty presentation.
usage: Select status from a host resource state machine.
Use refreshing to keep current content visible and stale when the last successful data remains useful.
Provide onRetry and drive retrying from the actual retry operation.
accessibility: Use meaningful names and preserve the shared control keyboard behavior.
Verify the real host integration, including focus and recovery, with keyboard and assistive technology.
intent: Present explicit host resource states while retaining existing content through refresh and stale-data states.
context: No fetching, caching, authentication, freshness timestamps or automatic state transitions.
Switching to initial-loading/empty/error intentionally unmounts retained children.
retrying is caller-controlled and must reflect the actual operation.
